# testdata

<!-- module-docs:start -->

Fixture chat templates for the `reasoning` tests, modeled on the upstream
templates of each model family and reduced to the message loop and the
markup the real templates render. `qwen3.jinja` carries thinking tags and is
a reasoning model; `qwen2_5.jinja`, `hermes2_pro.jinja`, `llama3_1.jinja` and
`deepseek_r1.jinja` are not.

<!-- module-docs:end -->
